LanguageData.VV_Letter_ViviEggHatched: A new Vivi has hatched from an egg laid by {PARENT_labelShort}. Vivi grow and learn faster than typical humans but have shorter lifespans. They also inherit random genetic modifiers at birth, including those from their mother. \nIf Vivi consume enough royal jelly during their growth stage, they develop into royal vivi, who live longer and can lay eggs. royal vivi have higher mental sensitivity and social skills but significantly lower work abilities and slower movement.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_ViviEggHatchedNoParent: A new Vivi has been born. Vivi grow and learn faster than typical humans but have shorter lifespans. They also inherit random genetic modifiers at birth, including those from their mother. \nIf Vivi consume enough royal jelly during their growth stage, they develop into royal vivi, who live longer and can lay eggs. royal vivi have higher mental sensitivity and social skills but significantly lower work abilities and slower movement.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_RoyalViviGrown: {PAWN_labelShort} has consumed enough royal jelly to grow into a royal vivi.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_IncidentHornetSwarmArrived: A frenzied swarm of titanic hornets has appeared. They will roam around and attack any life forms they encounter. Titanic hornets are very fast and durable, difficult to take down with conventional weapons, but vulnerable to fire and poison. \nThey cannot pass through doors, so hiding behind walls is safe. They will indiscriminately hunt the nearest targets, so it is advisable to hide if you lack adequate defenses. The swarm will hunt everything moving in the area and will leave on its own after a few days.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_LinkEverflower: {PAWN_labelShort} is resonant with the Everflower, establishing a mental link. As the Everflower's attune rank rises, you gain various beneficial effects and can use the everflower's abilities. \nThe everflower draws environment mana through the royal vivi, and the attune link strengthens whenever it absorbs mana or the resonant royal vivi performs an additional attunement ritual.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EverflowerAttumentLevelUp: The everflower's attunement level has increased The following rituals are now available.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_FairyficationComplete:
{CASTER_nameDef} has fairyficated {TARGET_nameDef}. The fairyficated vivi shrinks to a tiny form and follows the royal vivi. 
A fairy vivi does not experience time, has no needs, and cannot be attacked, but if the royal vivi dies it disperses and disappears. 
The fairy vivi usually does nothing but trail the royal vivi, though it may occasionally lend help. 

A fairy vivi can be returned to its original form through the defairyfication ritual, but this leaves lingering after-effects and while they persist the vivi cannot be fairyficated again.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_IncidentHornetAssaultArrived: A frenzied swarm of titanic hornets has appeared. They will roam around and attack any life forms they encounter. Titanic hornets are very fast and durable, difficult to take down with conventional weapons, but vulnerable to fire and poison. \nThey are drawn by mana waves, exhibiting strong aggression. Unlike typical titanic hornet swarms, they will attack everything in sight until all living beings and structures are destroyed.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EverflowerAttunementLevel5Prea: Resonating with the altar's mana circuits, the everflower has entered its fifth bloom.\n\nThe everflower's mana output grows stronger, everflower reverberation is sustained on adult non-royal vivis in the colony, and the resonator's everflower resonance deepens to stage V.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EverflowerAttunementLevel6Prea: With its sixth bloom, the everflower has come into full bloom. The weight of the bond, once borne by the resonator alone, has begun to flow into the flower as well.\n\nThe resonator's everflower resonance deepens to stage VI, removing the fatigue and movement penalties from bound fairy vivis, and adult vivis in the colony age much more slowly.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_ApocryphaRebirth: Though the giant hornet queen's form has collapsed and vanished, the cluster of lights left within has gathered to take shape once more. Countless fairy vivis wrap layer upon layer around Asphodel, the old empress; having temporarily regained a semblance of her past self, Asphodel will try to seize the everflower to carry out her own salvation.\n\nThe countless bound fairy vivis are taking every attack in her place. To stop the empress, attack and shatter her fairy veil, then have normal vivis resonate with the fairy blooms that sprout nearby and carry the tethered chain to the everflower altar to sever her bond with the fairy vivis.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_AsphodelFallen: "{QUOTE}"\n\nAs the fairy vivis around her came unbound, Asphodel's form dissolved into golden petals and drifted toward the everflower.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_FairyFlowerBound: Vivis near the fairy bloom lost their sense of self, turning into fairies and being drawn into Asphodel's embrace.\n\n{PAWNS}
LanguageData.VV_Letter_ApocryphaEmbrace: Vivis caught in Asphodel's resurrection embrace lost their sense of self, turning into fairies and being drawn into Asphodel's embrace.\n\n{PAWNS}
LanguageData.VV_Letter_AsphodelReleased: The vivis bound in Asphodel's embrace have been freed from their fairy form and returned to their true forms before the everflower.\n\n{PAWNS}
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingTale1: By long-standing custom, the vivi federation has sent the first volume of an old fairy tale book to the new nest that completed its attunement ritual. It tells of a great flower's shade, long ago, where no one knew how to wither.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingTale2: By custom, the vivi federation has sent the second volume of the old fairy tale book. It remembers a crowned ruler beneath the flower's shade, called the mother of all nests.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingTale3: The vivi federation has sent the third volume of the old fairy tale book. It shows the old queen, attended by little lights, guarding the trembling flower's shade.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingTale4: The vivi federation has sent the last volume of the old fairy tale book. It tells how, on the day darkness fell, the queen took the children beneath the shade into her arms as little lights, went far away, and lived happily ever after.\n\nThe everflower appears to have stopped growing any further, yet the fairy tales describe a far larger everflower once existing. To find a way forward, you can contact the federation and ask since when, and why, they have been sending these fairy tale books.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingRuinsDetected: The moment {PAWN_labelShort} resonated with the everflower, a brief wave of pure and powerful mana was felt from a nearby region.\n\n{PAWN_labelShort} quickly marked the location on the map, though the area is normally known to hold nothing at all. Still, a royal vivi in deep resonance with an everflower might be able to uncover something hidden there.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EverflowerEcho5:
As mana waves spread from the everflower, static entered {PAWN_labelShort}'s psychic circuits. This time it was no memory.

The whispers of countless voices and the sound of twisting bones. Something was approaching along the flow of mana.

"...Longed for... so warm..."
"...Back... to that flower's shade..."

The connection broke.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingSiege: As the altar's mana circuits awaken, the everflower has entered its fifth bloom. It begins condensing the mana needed for its final bloom, and the resonator's everflower resonance deepens to stage V.\n\nBut drawn by the mana waves spreading far from the altar, outlanders and swarms of titanic hornets are converging on the colony. Defend the altar and the assimilating resonator until the condensation is complete.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingSiegeFederation: Sensing the waves of the bloom, the vivi federation has formed an alliance with you. When enemies attack, the federation will send reinforcements to fight alongside you.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingSiegeFederationSupport: Sensing the waves of the bloom, the vivi federation has pledged its support. When enemies attack, the federation will send reinforcements to fight alongside you.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingFederationAid: The vivi federation has sent warriors to protect the flower's shade as it blooms again. They will fight alongside you for a time before returning home.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingCalm:
Just as the everflower neared full bloom and a golden pollen mist settled over the colony, a strange psychic wave stopped its petals. The approaching enemies fell back from the ominous presence, and silence settled over the colony.

Beyond the resonance, {PAWN_labelShort} felt countless little lights flickering. Beside the approaching shadow, one little light called a name in a trembling voice.

"...Asphodel... you can stop now..."
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingApocrypha:
Dark energy gathers above the everflower, and Asphodel, the old empress from the memories in the ruins, has appeared in the twisted form of a giant hornet queen. Swarms of titanic hornets drawn by corrupted mana follow behind her.

"...If only I had this shade... the crying... my children..."

Ancient eltex needles are lodged deep in her tough carapace. Perhaps you can make use of them.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingCoronation:
Following the golden petals of Asphodel's fading form, the little lights that stayed by her side to the end quietly flowed into {PAWN_labelShort}, who is assimilating with the everflower on the altar.

The long sleeplessness has finally ended, and the stilled everflower begins to pulse again.

You can now perform {PAWN_labelShort}'s coronation at the altar to complete the final bloom.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingVictoryContinue: You can continue playing in this colony. The resonator's everflower resonance reaches stage VI, removing the fatigue and movement penalties from the fairy bond, and adult vivis in the colony age much more slowly.\n\nYou can now perform the return of life, area purification, and land of flowers rituals at the fully bloomed everflower.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingFailureStolen: The everflower on the altar scattered into petals and was drawn into Asphodel. Holding the everflower to herself, the empress vanished again into the darkness beyond the wind of petals.\n\nWith the everflower lost, the final bloom has been interrupted. However, once you prepare an altar and everflower again, you can start the full bloom ritual anew...
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingFailureLost: With the altar or everflower lost, the final bloom has been interrupted. However, once you prepare an altar and everflower again, you can start the full bloom ritual anew...
LanguageData.VV_Letter_EndingFailureResonator: {PAWN_labelShort} has fallen, severing the resonance with the everflower. The final bloom has been interrupted.\n\nOnce a new resonator arises, you can start the full bloom ritual anew at the altar.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_AncientWitnessLabel: Memory of an old wing, awakened
LanguageData.VV_Letter_AncientWitness:
Having regained a body after long ages, {PAWN_labelShort} gazed up for a while at the golden flower's shade spread overhead. After a steadying breath, {PAWN_labelShort} carefully told of the last day she remembered.

"It was the day the acrid smoke and flames reached into the shade. Lady Asphodel stood alone on the dais. She told us not to cry, that it would not hurt once we became little lights, and she held us close."

"After we became light, it felt as if I was holding her tight in a long, dark dream, listening to crying that never stopped. I wanted to let her go... Now I open my eyes, and she is asleep too, and spring really has come again."

{PAWN_labelShort} quietly bowed her head and said she would live on beneath this flower's shade, found once more.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_FederationReaction:
Having seen the wave of full bloom rise from your colony, the vivi federation has sent its congratulations.

The federation never knew the original reason it had sent old fairy tale books to new nests. But seeing the great flower's shade of legend truly bloom again after centuries, they say they were filled with deep awe.

The vivi federation honors the colony led by its new queen and promises lasting friendship.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_QueenLifeResonance: On the verge of death, {PAWN_nameDef} scattered into golden petals and came to rest within the everflower. Her wounds have healed, and she will awaken in {TIME}.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_ReturnOfLife: {PAWN_labelShort}, an ancient vivi once released from Asphodel's bond, has regained a body through the power of the fully bloomed everflower and joined the colony.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_RuinEcho1:
As {PAWN_labelShort} touched the fairy bloom growing in the ruins, a broken voice came through with a surge of pain.

"...So heavy... the voices... won't stop..."

Someone's attunement was collapsing, and a once-lovely body was twisting black. Through countless unknown cries, a few barely intelligible words escaped.

"...Can't sleep... my children... I... who was..."

Countless little lights wrapped the wailing shadow, binding it layer upon layer, and sank with it beyond the dark.

The fairy bloom scattered, revealing the vast ruins before you.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_RuinEcho2:
At the touch of the second fairy bloom, a memory older than the one before flowed into {PAWN_labelShort}.

Someone was opening their circuits to the limit. Countless falling vivis turned into little lights and gathered into a single soul.

"...Don't cry... once you are little lights... it won't hurt..."
"...Not a single one... will I lose... into my arms... all of you..."

With every child gathered up as light, not one breath was left on the field. Even after waking from the memory, {PAWN_labelShort} struggled to catch a breath for some time.

The fairy bloom scattered, opening the way into the deeper corridor.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_RuinEcho3:
At the touch of the third fairy bloom, a ringing filled {PAWN_labelShort}'s head, and with it a memory older still.

Golden petals trembled faintly above a vast altar. Beneath the flower's shade, everything was covered in thick green toxic clouds and flames. Terrified vivis fled past amid gunfire and explosions.

"...The flowers... are burning..."
"...On the dais... I am all alone... at this rate, everyone..."

Only a few little lights remained beside the shadow standing on the burning dais. {PAWN_labelShort} came to in a cold sweat.

The fairy bloom scattered, opening the way into the circular gallery surrounding the sanctum.
LanguageData.VV_Letter_RuinEcho4:
At the touch of the last fairy bloom before the altar, the oldest memory left in this place unfolded before {PAWN_labelShort}'s eyes.

A radiant golden flower bloomed atop a vast altar. Beneath its shade, where warm pollen drifted, countless vivis wore peaceful faces free of worry, as if they had forgotten the cold outside.

"...In this warm shade... never withering..."
"...Don't worry... your spring... I will, to the very end..."

Beyond the gentle whispers, a name rang out. The crowd that filled the shade looked up to the crowned mother on the dais and called out as one.

"...Blessings upon our empress, Asphodel..."

The cheers sank into distant static, and the last fairy bloom scattered. The ancient amber core can now be extracted from the central altar.
